title: Mid-level iOS engineer (Swift / SwiftUI / UIKit)
description: A 4-year iOS engineer with a Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit/Core Data stack evaluated against 8 postings: one strong senior-iOS match with legacy-modernization gaps, one semantically equivalent mobile role phrased without any Apple-ecosystem brand names, one marginal Android role, and five cross-domain distractors.
rationale: j2 describes the resume's exact competency — building a native app for a major mobile ecosystem, migrating imperative screens to a declarative UI framework, first-party persistence and test frameworks — using generic vocabulary that shares zero tokens with the resume's skill names (Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Core Data, XCTest, Xcode Instruments), so TF-IDF has no signal while embeddings should recognize the match. Gap target j1 overlaps strongly (Swift, UIKit, SwiftUI, Core Data, XCTest, Fastlane all demanded or mentioned) while requiring Objective-C and GraphQL, which the resume clearly lacks (high), RxSwift, which is only partially covered by the resume's Combine experience (medium), and WidgetKit as a preferred item (low) — justifying grade 3 with unambiguous annotated gaps. j3 (Android) probes the graded boundary: same mobile job family and genuinely transferable fundamentals, but a different ecosystem and core stack, hence grade 1. The remaining five jobs are cross-domain distractors with no meaningful overlap.

resume.summary: iOS engineer with 4 years shipping consumer apps in Swift. Equally at home in SwiftUI and UIKit, and owns features end to end: design collaboration, Core Data persistence, XCTest coverage, and App Store release automation with Fastlane.

jobs.raw_text:
Senior iOS Engineer — Ledgerly (Hybrid, New York NY)

Ledgerly is a personal-finance app with 2M monthly users and a nine-year-old codebase. We are hiring a Senior iOS Engineer to ship new money-movement features while modernizing the legacy stack.

What you will do:
- Ship account and payments features in Swift across UIKit and SwiftUI surfaces
- Modernize the legacy Objective-C modules screen by screen
- Own the Core Data persistence layer and its migration paths
- Keep the XCTest unit and UI suites green in CI

Requirements: Swift, UIKit, Objective-C, GraphQL, and RxSwift. 4+ years building native iOS applications; at least one app shipped end to end on the App Store. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have: SwiftUI, WidgetKit, Fastlane.

Mobile Engineer, Native Apps — Harborline (Remote, US)

Harborline's flagship consumer app helps 1.5M people plan coastal trips. We deliberately describe this role in terms of craft, not brand names — if you have deep native experience on a major mobile platform, we want to talk.

You will build and ship features for our flagship native application on a major mobile ecosystem, migrate screens from the platform's older imperative UI toolkit to its declarative UI framework, and hunt down startup and scrolling regressions with the vendor's profiling tools.

We look for: native application development for a major mobile ecosystem, fluency with a declarative UI framework and its state-driven patterns, the platform's structured local persistence framework, and automated testing with the platform's first-party test framework. 3+ years shipping native mobile applications. Bonus: reactive event-stream programming; automated release pipelines to the platform's app marketplace.
